_README.purpose: Per-unit inference config. Set 'source' for each unit to its real camera URL or file path.
_README.source_field: RTSP/HTTP URL or absolute file path. Leave empty to fall back to videos/<unit>/*.mp4
_README.ROI_and_line: Coordinates are NORMALIZED (0.0-1.0). x=0.25 means 25% from left, w=0.50 means 50% width. Adjust per camera angle.
